scripts.build: yarn build:remindme && yarn build:todo && yarn build:calendar && yarn build:assembleemail
scripts.deploy:remindme: cd dist/remind-me && zip function.zip index.js && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name remind-me --zip-file fileb://function.zip
scripts.deploy:todo: cd dist/get-todos && zip function.zip index.js && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name get-todos --zip-file fileb://function.zip
scripts.deploy:calendar: cd dist/get-calendar && zip function.zip index.js && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name get-calendar --zip-file fileb://function.zip
scripts.deploy:assembleemail: cd dist/assemble-email && zip function.zip index.js && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name assemble-email --zip-file fileb://function.zip
